sharedPitfalls.summary: Finishing `delivery-profile` does NOT finish shipping, and stopping there is the single most repeated defect in this domain. A working region needs THREE resources, and the import order reflects that: (1) the region and its carriers on the profile; (2) a ShippingOption per paid/free delivery choice -- a carrier's backupRate alone leaves the region non-functional at checkout and still shows Wix's 'missing rates' warning; (3) a PickupLocation for any collection point, plus the Pickup carrier attached with an INACTIVE backup rate. Each of these was live-observed missing on a real store while the API read-back looked complete.
